values.binNote: Wiki gives the slow's magnitude as a positive percent (40 to 60); the bin stores it as a negative move speed modifier (-0.4 to -0.6), same magnitude, opposite sign convention for a debuff. Not a real disagreement, just sign convention.

values.meaning: Expand delay before the grenade turns into the slow field / begins returning

mechanics.claim: Enemies can only be hit once per pass (once by the outgoing grenade, once by the returning grenade).
mechanics.quote: Enemies can be hit only once per pass.

mechanics.claim: A spell shield blocks only one of the two damage instances (outgoing or return), not both.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block only a single instance of damage.

mechanics.claim: Hitting an enemy champion, or reaching 700 units, triggers the expansion into the slow field early; otherwise it expands at 700 units regardless.
mechanics.quote: At 700 units or upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}}, the grenade slows down for {{fd|1.75}} seconds to gradually expand

mechanics.claim: After expanding, the grenade contracts and homes back to Ekko at increased speed, dealing the return damage on the way back.
mechanics.quote: Afterwards, the grenade contracts and homes back to '''Ekko''' at an increased speed, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
